# Larch-12 parcel-sort replay result

Invented synthetic local measurement, not a production result.

Build: Larch-12. Run: PS-12. Protocol: parcel-sort replay, 600 fabricated parcel jobs, one local worker, fixed input sequence.

Job-latency p95: 72 milliseconds. Failed jobs: 2 of 600. Observed job failure rate: 0.33 percent, rounded to two decimal places.

Both recorded metrics refer to the synthetic local replay only. No measurements of real parcels or customer traffic were made.
